variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ossian of the Drowned Lantern, Dunstan the smith, Mabry the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: It's awful quiet tonight, with the north gate shut and all.

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: The ferrymen have doubled the fare across the river.

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: Perhaps you'd care for a potion or a spell book?

variants.writer: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), writer 1

variants.specifics: Ostrum: Gubbin keeps the inn, Tarsk the arms and armour, Zephrin the potions and spell books.

inn.speaker: Gubbin
inn.text: You're a bold one, poking your nose around Ostrum.

arms.speaker: Tarsk
arms.text: Hard times, lad. I never thought the Ogres would break through into the Copper Deep. A sorry business indeed! Best buy what you need while I still have it!

magic.speaker: Zephrin
magic.text: What is it you want, Wanderer? I have work to do.

variants.specifics: Vell: Bodo keeps the inn, Kessik the forge, Ystra the potion and spell shop.

inn.speaker: Bodo
inn.text: You've no business back here. Best get out of my kitchen.

arms.speaker: Kessik
arms.text: Sorry, stranger, the Marsh Guard bought up the lot! I haven't a single shield left to sell you.

magic.speaker: Ystra
magic.text: Hello, stranger. You know Grulga's Trolls have been asking after you.

variants.specifics: Tarnhold: Pobbin of the Rusty Helm inn, Brokk the smith, Quilla the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Pobbin
inn.text: So, you've got both Captain Orlo's letter and the Baron's ear. Good for you, young sir!

arms.speaker: Brokk
arms.text: Times are bad. Buy something, before I test this new mace on your skull!

magic.speaker: Quilla
magic.text:
Wanna taste my newest potion?

I call it 'Ogre-Be-Gone.'

variants.specifics: Tolvin: Porley of the Bent Hook inn, Hobb the smith, Esmolde who sells potions and scrolls.

inn.speaker: Porley
inn.text: Pssst! This way! You looking for a soft bed? A bowl of chowder, maybe?

arms.speaker: Hobb
arms.text: Rogues shut the north road. Need a sword?

magic.speaker: Esmolde
magic.text: Hmm... Not the cheapest potions, I admit... But mighty strong all the same!

variants.specifics: Olvane: Pumbric of the Brass Owl inn, Dobbo the arms dealer (who thinks the player robbed him), Vashti of the potion shop.

inn.speaker: Pumbric
inn.text:
Not from around here, eh? Most folks up at the College turn their noses up at outsiders, but they've never set foot outside these walls and I've been everywhere! What do they know!? Huh? Heh, heh, heh...

You're welcome at the Brass Owl anytime, sir.

arms.speaker: Dobbo
arms.text: Get out THIEF! Before I fetch Brunt!

magic.speaker: Vashti
magic.text: I hear Grelvin's Undead are coming down from the Observatory. Might be time for me to pack up my potions and find another town.

variants.specifics: Fort Ostkar: Bornik the innkeeper, Gribb the smith, Zell of the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Bornik
inn.text: I trust you won't need a bed here for long, stranger. You look like someone with plenty left to do.

arms.speaker: Gribb
arms.text: Pssst! Hey! Pal! Need a sword? Lowest price in the pass and they're forged right here in Fort Ostkar!

variants.specifics: Orvak: Murdo of the Sooty Mug inn, Grondel the armourer, Zarna the potion and scroll seller.

inn.speaker: Murdo
inn.text: This is the Sooty Mug. I doubt you'll get much sleep here, stranger.

arms.speaker: Grondel
arms.text: A stranger, eh? You'd better turn back while you still can. No doubt them Imps will be raiding the forges any day now, too! Dangerous days we're living in, isn't it?

magic.speaker: Zarna
magic.text: Not many travelers come through lately. Orvak isn't much of a holiday spot these days, what with cutthroats robbing every wagon on the road.

variants.specifics: Torvel Cross: Gulliam of the Lame Mule inn, Brodd the smith, Ysmay of the potion shop.

inn.speaker: Gulliam
inn.text: Sorry, friend, but my cellar's run a bit low. Ogres on the road always make folks thirsty. Heh, heh, heh...

variants.specifics: Corvale: Tamsy of the Muddy Boot inn, Grobbel the smith, Quillda's potion shop.

inn.speaker: Tamsy
inn.text: Hungry travelers are always welcome at the Muddy Boot. What'll it be?

arms.speaker: Grobbel
arms.text: You'd better be quick the Ogres could come back any minute.

magic.speaker: Quillda
magic.text: You look like you could use a potion or two, friend.
